name: Bloom
description: Sticky session mode that turns flat markdown into rich, self-contained .html artifacts. Activate with /bloom once and every substantial output for the rest of the session — status reports, PR reviews, design docs, comparisons, plans, diagrams, slide decks, postmortems, triage boards, flag and prompt editors — becomes a single browsable .html file with semantic HTML5, inline CSS/JS, and zero external dependencies. Reserved files like README.md, CLAUDE.md, and AGENTS.md keep their canonical markdown and gain a richer .html companion next to them. Deactivate with /bloom-off at any time.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, `bloom` (Per-session sticky mode that makes markdown bloom into rich, self-contained .html artifacts — reports, reviews, plans, docs, comparisons,…), `bloom-plan` (Decision-transparent planning).

Installs with `claude plugin install bloom@claude-community` from `SunnyDevendranadh/HTML.md` (`plugins/bloom`).
